rows.reason: Exchange format is a property of the RTL: data launched and captured on both clock edges, with an SDR test mode. Checked by RTL simulation of rtl/aib_datapath.v; the same inputs give the same outputs, no device variation enters.
Wire count N per direction is a structural parameter of the RTL (N = 20, fallback N = 8, instantiated lane by lane) and of the layout column; it is a count, not a measured quantity.

Shift redundancy is a mux function. The check enumerates every single-fault position (20 per direction, 40 total, DR-0016) in RTL simulation and formal equivalence; the outcome is exact for each case, not a distribution.
Sequential latency is counted in clock cycles on the RTL (TX input register to RX output register, 1.5 cycles each way); analog delays are excluded by the row itself.
Loopback modes L1 and L2 are selected by control inputs of the RTL; each mode is a fixed routing of enumerated signals, simulated per mode, with no variation dependence.
